gui.grindless.quest.title: Quest Book
gui.grindless.guide.title: Field Guide
gui.grindless.guide.bootstrap.title: Bootstrap
gui.grindless.guide.bootstrap.body: Three crafts end the opening grind. The Multitool is cobblestone and sticks. It turns a Grindless block, and it does not mine. The Hand Crank Dynamo is two iron, and it feeds the first machine. The Crude Extractor pulls the chunk vein. A Data Core is cobble and redstone. The Research Terminal spends one core to open Voltaic.
gui.grindless.guide.voltaic.title: Voltaic
gui.grindless.guide.voltaic.body: Voltaic is the first blueprint. The factory researches it, and the unlock is the world's, not one player's. The Arc Furnace, the Pulverizer, the Thermal Generator, the Flux Pylon and the belts are that first factory. The furnace is the spine of the metals after it. The Process Atlas lists the live recipes. It does not solve a line.
gui.grindless.guide.contact.title: Contact
gui.grindless.guide.contact.body: Industrial is the second blueprint. The same terminal spends an Advanced Data Core. The Chemical Reactor is manufactured, not hand-crafted: one casing, two motors and four plates. A vanadia pellet and held air turn sulfur dioxide into sulfur trioxide, then acid. Pickle spends that acid on an iron plate. That is the contact process.
gui.grindless.guide.metals.title: Metals
gui.grindless.guide.metals.body: The Arc Furnace turns ten iron ingots and one carbon into ten steel ingots. Carbon is coal. One slag becomes one refractory brick. Sand or nether quartz, with two carbon, becomes metallurgical silicon, and ten of those become seven electronic silicon. The furnace still holds 1500 °C. An off-band run costs time, never yield.
gui.grindless.guide.array.title: Ground Array
gui.grindless.guide.array.body: The Ground Array is a fixed 3 by 3: one controller and eight casings, both Assembler recipes under Industrial. A complete ring under a pylon stores 6553600 FU, ten seconds of MK3 throughput. It does not generate. It is not a Kardashev scale.
gui.grindless.guide.voyage.title: Voyage
gui.grindless.guide.voyage.body: A survey rocket climbs to the ceiling. The landing map offers home and Luna. Leaving home spends 102400 FU. Leaving Luna does not. Luna is regolith and has no ore. An extractor there emits helium-3. The Lunar Link remains as a placeholder. The station is the ride off the star, and its ceiling is the Drift, one deck with no ore. Leaving any world but the Drift spends the array buffer. The Starward Link stays, and it does not move a player.
gui.grindless.guide.centre.title: The galactic centre
gui.grindless.guide.centre.body: Riding the station on from the Drift arrives in a sealed chamber. The mass is unbreakable horizon shell. The room holds one berth, one mark and a shaft the ride home climbs. Leaving the Drift draws nothing. Leaving the chamber draws nothing and returns to the berth saved on the way out. Arriving is the victory.
